name: Admin Project State Catalog
description: The Administrar estados action opens the shared state-catalog component scoped to projects. It shows the seven seeded meanings (En desarrollo, Activo, En evolución, Pausado, Suspendido, Completado and Dado de baja), contextual help, usage and historical counts, and lets the admin create, describe, rename, recolor, merge or retire reusable states. Each project state also configures whether its projects appear by default in the Documents project-folder section; this catalog value drives the filter instead of a hard-coded status list. Editable names and descriptions stay separate from the immutable operational effect and derived consequence help that control and explain billing and closure. A state in use cannot change effect or be retired, and failed catalog writes preserve the local draft so the user can retry.
